name: parametric-kitchen-simple
description: Interaction ladder for C270 — parametric kitchen-run. Verifies: (1) Kitchen run tab appears in pro mode with kitchenCabinets flag, (2) kitchen controls render (bay slider, upper-cabinets toggle, bay-style pickers), (3) toggling bay 1 to drawers updates the preview, (4) add-to-room saves item into the scene.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-kitchen-flag
steps.eval: const flags = window.__store.getState().featureFlags; if (!flags.kitchenCabinets) throw new Error('kitchenCabinets flag is OFF — expected ON in pro mode')

steps.name: click-bay-1-drawer
steps.eval: (function() { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-label^="Bay 1:"]')); const drawerBtn = btns.find(b => b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Bay 1: Drawer'); if (drawerBtn) drawerBtn.click(); })()

steps.name: add-to-room
steps.eval: (function() { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const addBtn = btns.find(b => b.textContent && b.textContent.trim() === 'Add to room'); if (!addBtn) throw new Error('Add to room button not found'); addBtn.click(); })()

steps.name: verify-item-in-scene
steps.eval: (function() { const items = window.__store.getState().items; if (!items || items.length === 0) throw new Error('No items in scene after add-to-room'); })()
